explanation: The repeated characteristic root is r=10λ, so y=(A+Bx)e^{rx}. The boundary conditions give rA+(1+r)B=0 and (1+2r)A+4(1+r)B=0. Their determinant is (1+r)(2r-1), so r=-1 or 1/2, yielding λ=-1/10 or 1/20. Correspondingly, A=0 or A=-3B, giving Bxe^{-x} and Ce^{x/2}(x-3), with nonzero constants.
